name: Konar quo Maten

economy.diaryBoostNote: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary raises points per task from 18 to 20; milestone bonuses scale with the boosted base.

notes: Assigns a specific location alongside each monster; kills only count toward the task in that location.
Never assigns Wilderness locations (outside of boss Slayer) - those belong to Krystilia.
Task monsters can drop brimstone keys (drop rates similar to Larran's keys) for the brimstone chest beside her.
Offers the most points per task outside the Wilderness - more than Duradel.
Combat level requirement can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape (99 Slayer).
